target_customer: Provider offices, billing companies and practices that call insurance payors for eligibility, prior authorization and claim status
problem: Provider office staff spend hours on hold and on repetitive calls to payors for benefit verification, prior authorization and claim status.
business_model: B2B AI voice automation, likely usage or subscription based (pricing not found)
product_category: Healthcare administrative automation, voice AI for payor calls

founders.name: Sneh Patel
founders.background_notes: Per YC page. Some sources credit Patel as sole founder.

founders.name: Kimberly McManus
previous_startups: Be Golden (inflammation measurement; the YC page shows its launch post)
founders.background_notes: Per YC page. Search results suggest she may no longer be active, unconfirmed.

competitors.name: Infinitus Systems
competitors.what: Automates healthcare phone calls to payers, including benefit verification, using voice AI
competitors.funding_then: Series A and seed totaled $21.4 million per its blog; a $30 million Series B was reported by Fierce Healthcare (date not confirmed)

technical_complexity.rationale: Navigating IVR menus, hold queues and live reps needs speech and language models plus reliability; in 2022 generative AI was early, but a small team could build it from existing speech APIs.

defensibility.rationale: Call transcripts per payor could compound, but rivals like Infinitus were ahead and the wedge is copyable.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Later entrants such as SuperDial (raised $15M in June 2025) and Prosper AI entered the same space; no acquisition of Delfino found.

market_need_then: US providers spend heavy staff time on payor calls; the pain was a known cost center, though the 2022 text-only source set offers no spend figures.

identity.visual_style: shows school logos for team credibility
identity.voice_and_tone: plain product copy about call types

brand_strength.rationale: No press or community about the brand found. The name is confusable with Delfina, a maternal health company that raised $17M, which appeared in search results.

outcome_analysis: Delfino AI remains a tiny two person team per the YC page with no disclosed funding beyond aggregator mentions of a $500K pre-seed. No shutdown, acquisition or layoff news was found. The company entered a crowded niche led by Infinitus, and its outcome is not yet visible from public sources.
notes: Funding unverified: aggregators (VCBacked, Employbl, PitchBook via Healthcare Discovery) list about $500K pre-seed or accelerator money dated Jan or Sep 2022 with conflicting labels; no round recorded. Founded year is 2021 per YC page; another source says 2023. Infinitus date of Series B not confirmed, so source_date is null. Completeness pass: recorded a pre-seed in 2022-09 (VCBacked, Extruct) and an accelerator round on 2024-03-12 (CB Insights only). Amounts null; CB Insights totals 500K over three rounds. Databases only.
